state.background: Final reconciliation checkpoint for the Phase 2 full Browser Mode migration roster. The roster at results/plan45/phase2/full-migration-roster.md now states that all 89 eligible rows are Verified/full across five batches (20/20/20/20/9), with each row mapping its eligible source predicate to a Browser Mode destination and documenting distinct production integration assertions that remain separately scoped. The independent row-by-row audit of rows 1-20 found matching production-route Browser Mode cases for rows 1-16 and 19-20 and no specific predicate gaps. For rows 17-18, Browser Mode tests use the actual StackedAreaChart and EarningsBreakdownChart components with synthetic monthly data to assert omission of the same two final SVG-axis labels (2017-12 and 2018-01); the source E2E file exists in git HEAD and was removed during this migration. The audit also notes that broader CPI smoke and separate CAGR route-entry checks remain. Batch 1 JEV result is valid_as_defined with passProbability 0.71. Batch 2-5 result records are available alongside their request files. Final production-route suite evidence after Batch 5: Chromium 78/78 passed; WebKit 21 passed and 5 skipped. Consolidated E2E after Batch 5: 32 passed and 19 skipped (51 total). Lint passed. Type-check exits 2 because of pre-existing Browser Mode component diagnostics; it is not being reported as passing. The JEV checkpoint must judge the completeness and evidence for the roster reconciliation; do not infer that skipped tests passed or that type-check passed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every eligible row in the 89-row roster has a concrete Browser Mode destination that covers its mapped live source predicate, with any distinct production integration assertion explicitly retained or separately owned.
The #1-20 row-by-row audit findings and source removals are represented accurately, including the actual-chart component evidence for #17-18 and their source file removal in this migration.
Batch verification counts and skipped tests are stated accurately; E2E and lint evidence are not conflated with type-check, whose current run has known diagnostics and exit code 2.
The roster does not claim that non-migrated independent smoke or route-entry assertions were transferred, and does not count skipped tests as passing.
verification: Final production-route run recorded for Batch 5: Chromium 78 passed / 78 total; WebKit 21 passed and 5 skipped.
Post-Batch5 consolidated E2E: 32 passed, 19 skipped, 51 total.
pnpm type-check exited 2 with pre-existing Browser Mode component diagnostics; no pass is claimed.

Independent #1-20 audit: #1-16 and #19-20 matched production-route Browser Mode cases with no identified predicate gap; #17-18 matched final-axis omissions in real chart component Browser Mode tests using synthetic monthly data; source E2E deletion is part of this migration; broader CPI smoke and separate CAGR route-entry checks remain.

state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice and return a probability distribution. For any reason choice, give a case-specific finding, the affected row/location or acceptance criterion, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied roster and evidence support accepting the final full-migration status against the acceptance criteria? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied evidence supports the 89-row roster status and the stated qualifications against the criteria.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The acceptance criteria or roster definition conflicts with the intended migration; identify the row/requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required source mapping, verification, or ownership evidence is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The roster or implementation evidence is incomplete; identify the row/location and missing details or evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: A row's mapped predicate is not fully represented or a status/evidence statement is inaccurate; identify location, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The claimed completion includes a predicate outside the eligible scope or omits a required in-scope predicate; identify boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; identify location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
